title: smithy#model-connection
description: Connect a Smithy project to a Smithy shape library

sourceProject.description: The Smithy project to connect from. Either a smithy#project, or a ts#smithy-api project (in which case its model project is connected)

targetProject.description: The smithy#project shape library to connect to

preferInstallDependencies.description: Whether to prefer installing dependencies after the generator runs. Set to false to defer installing when batching multiple generators (an install still runs if needed so subsequent generators can compute the Nx project graph); install once at the end.
